Two days ago (the 10th), the Home Affairs Department announced the "Woh Tsai Shan Enhancement Plan," which will remove the unauthorised structures long placed on Bishop's Hill in Sham Shui Po in phases. The first phase covers the area from the foot of the hill to the summit at the Tong Yam Street hillside rest area, while the second phase covers the area from the foot of the hill to the summit near Berwick Street.

Currently, the second phase area still retains a number of fitness equipment and statues, and residents can be seen on site playing shuttlecock, table tennis, and using the fitness equipment. As for the area around the Tong Yam Street hillside rest area, barbed wire and hoarding were already put up last night, with security guards stationed this morning to prevent residents from entering.
